title: Shell-and-tube heat exchanger
goal: A process engineer can trace the separate hot and cold circuits through E-101 and read the outlet temperature-control loop and maintenance connections.

rubric.must: A shell-and-tube exchanger labelled E-101 is the visible centre of the drawing.
Hot glycol and cooling-water process paths are visibly separate circuits through different exchanger connections.
TT-101, TIC-101 and TV-101 form a readable temperature-control loop associated with the hot outlet.
Both circuits show labelled inlet and outlet isolation valves.
A high-point vent and low-point drain are visibly connected to the exchanger.
The temperature-control signal lines are visually distinct from process piping.
Where the hot and cold circuits cross or approach, the picture does not imply they are connected.

ideal.notes: Drafted by Codex from the source and the rubric, without seeing the engine's own output. It preferred the svg: The SVG satisfies both blockers and clearly shows the specified hot-outlet temperature-control loop, while the picture senses the tube-side outlet and controls the hot inlet using a differently tagged valve.
